scripts.deploy:production: pnpm run console:build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && wrangler types --check --env-file .dev.vars.example && pnpm run console:typecheck && pnpm run docs:typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run openapi:check && pnpm test && pnpm run console:test && pnpm run docs:build
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env local
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --env local --file seeds/dev-app.sql

CF_AIG_GATEWAY_ID.description: Required. [Create a Cloudflare AI Gateway](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=%2F%3Aaccount%2Fai%2Fai-gateway) first, then enter its exact Gateway ID (slug). This deployment does not create a gateway.

CF_AIG_TOKEN.description: After creating the gateway, open its Settings and select **Create authentication token**. Save the one-time token and paste it here; it includes the required AI Gateway Run permission.
